project_info.theme: Adult subject breaking out of a fictional social-post frame
project_info.creative_direction: photoreal composite using perspective distortion and interface-inspired graphic design
project_info.color_palette: yellow floor, purple graffiti puffer, black, gold jewelry, white sneakers, and clean white frame

main_subject.detail: approved adult subject wearing black cap, black sunglasses, black T-shirt, purple graffiti-pattern puffer jacket, layered gold chain, and white sneakers
main_subject.action: standing while holding both vertical frame edges, upper body projecting outside the frame with realistic contact shadows

composition_elements.framing: high top-down view with strong 10mm fisheye effect applied to the person only, enlarged head and smaller body, while the rectangular frame stays straight
composition_elements.interface: fictional social-post frame with abstract avatar, generic handle, simple heart/comment/share/bookmark icons, and no real platform logo or personal handle
composition_elements.background: clean yellow floor with controlled shadows and no clutter

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: large soft overhead source at approximately 5200K with directional fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: realistic contact shadows under hands and frame, fisheye edge distortion, crisp streetwear texture, playful surreal depth

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 10mm fisheye lens, photorealistic composite photography
technical_specs.finish: accurate perspective, realistic fabric and skin texture, clean interface graphics, restrained saturation

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic photo composite of an approved clearly adult person breaking out of a fictional social-post frame. The adult subject stands while holding both vertical frame edges, with the upper body projecting outside the frame and realistic contact shadows. Use a high top-down view and a strong 10mm fisheye effect on the person only, creating a larger head and smaller body while keeping the frame straight. The subject has a confident upward gaze and wears a purple graffiti-pattern puffer jacket, black T-shirt, layered gold chain, white sneakers, black cap, and black sunglasses. Place the frame over a clean yellow floor. Use a fictional social-post interface with an abstract avatar, generic handle, simple icons, and no real platform logo or personal handle. Use soft overhead light at approximately 5200K, realistic hand/frame shadows, photorealistic fabric texture, and playful surreal depth.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, celebrity likeness, real platform logo, real personal handle, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed hands, warped frame, broken perspective, illegible UI text
